nodes.label: Net.fbs
nodes.desc: FlatBuffer schema defining the Net, Op, and Tensor tables every MNN model file is serialized into.

nodes.label: Interpreter
nodes.desc: Classic entry point: createFromFile/createFromBuffer deserialize a Net and createSession kicks off scheduling.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.desc: Owns the scheduled op list and runtimes; Session::run drives one inference pass over the ops.

nodes.label: Schedule
nodes.desc: Splits the Net into per-backend op groups, picking CPU vs GPU from ScheduleConfig and device support.

nodes.label: RuntimeFactory
nodes.desc: Creates a Runtime instance for each scheduled backend type via registered creators.

nodes.label: Backend
nodes.desc: Abstract Runtime/Backend contract every device backend implements, including onCreate for Execution objects.

nodes.label: CPURuntime
nodes.desc: CPU runtime and backend: threads, memory pools, and dispatch of ops to CPU executions.

nodes.label: ConvTiled
nodes.desc: Tiled im2col+GEMM convolution kernel family, the workhorse of CPU conv inference.

nodes.label: Module
nodes.desc: Expr-level loadable network object: Module::load reads a model file and forwards VARP tensors.

nodes.label: Executor
nodes.desc: Expr runtime that lazily creates and caches Runtime instances for eager VARP execution.

nodes.label: Llm
nodes.desc: MNN-LLM engine: loads the transformer as a Module, runs prefill and token-by-token decode.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.desc: SentencePiece/BPE tokenizer for text-to-ids before inference and ids-to-text after.
